description: Search EU public procurement notices on TED by CPV code, country and publication date. Returns deduplicated, structured, organisation-level records with attribution.

collapseByProcedure.description: Keep only the latest notice per procedure

countries.description: Country codes, ISO alpha-2 (FI) or alpha-3 (FIN)

countryField.description: Match buyer country or place of performance

cpvCodes.description: CPV codes, 8 digits (e.g. "72000000" IT services). Hierarchical: parent codes match children.

language.description: Preferred title language, ISO 639-2/B, e.g. eng, fin, swe, deu

noticeTypes.description: Groups: competition, planning, award, change; or raw TED notice types like cn-standard

name: ted_search_tenders
title: Search EU public tenders (TED)
